title: Grateful Dead Live at Family Dog at the Great Highway on 1969-08-03
venue: Family Dog at the Great Highway
lineage: Reel Master (Studer A80) > Sonoma Systems DSD > Dobly Stretched Decode > WAV (24-bit/96k)Mastering Info:WAV > Adobe Audition CC 2015 > Samplitude Pro X3 Suite > FLAC/24

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a wild 1969 show featuring stellar guests and a mind‑blowing Dark Star/Caution marathon
ai_review.review: The recording, sourced from the soundboard, delivers crystal‑clear audio that lets listeners soak in the chaotic yet inspired first half and the soaring second‑set jams. Reviewers rave about the guest fiddler/saxophonist, David Nelson’s Mama Tried solo, the beautiful High Time, and especially the incendiary Lounge Lizard → Dark Star → 40‑minute free‑jazz Caution stretch.

ai_rating.rationale: Single 5‑star review praises both the musical performance (high energy, standout jams) and indicates a high‑quality soundboard source; limited data reduces confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No technical complaints; soundboard FLAC24 provides clear, detailed mix.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First half described as organized chaos with vocal duels, transitioning into a beautiful full‑band High Time before launching into an extended, experimental jam sequence.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia is highlighted for sharing verses on Hi‑Heel Sneakers and his overall presence in the chaotic first half.
